raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE Business Analyst Capgemini (Pune) (Sep 2023 - Present)
Project: VISTA New Customer Integration (NCI) - Synchrony Financial ( Dec 25 - till date ) Responsibilities Supported modernization of Synchrony's VISTA Card Servicing Platform, enabling seamless integration of new customers, accounts, and
servicing capabilities across the retail cards ecosystem.
Defined servicing requirements and integration capabilities across customer profiles, account servicing, transaction visibility, authorizations,
and card controls, enhancing operational efficiency and customer experience.
Partnered with business, operations, and technology teams to deliver a unified customer and account view, strengthening servicing
effectiveness and operational controls.
Project: UK Card and Dispute Management (UKCD) - Barclays ( Nov 24 - Dec 25) Responsibilities Led business analysis and solution design initiatives across UK Cards and Dispute Management, defining target-state processes and operating
models.
Defined end-to-end business process and integration requirements for card issuance, authorization, settlement, chargebacks, and dispute
management.
Defined the Target Operating Model (TOM) for UK Cards and Dispute Management by assessing existing operating processes, identifying
process gaps and defining the desired future-state operating model across business, operations and technology teams. Identified opportunities to standardize Cards and Dispute Management processes, roles and operational hand-offs across the target operating model to improve consistency, control and operational efficiency
Mapped AS-IS to TO-BE operating processes across card issuance, authorization, settlement, chargebacks and dispute management,
identifying opportunities for process standardization, improved controls and operational efficiency.
Worked with business, operations and technology stakeholders to define future-state roles, process flows, system interactions and customer
servicing journeys, ensuring alignment between the target operating model and the transformed Cards operating environment.
Shaped API-led architecture and customer servicing journeys through collaboration with business, technology, and operations stakeholders. Facilitated stakeholder workshops, drove process optimization, and improved dispute resolution efficiency and operational controls. Supported Agile delivery, UAT governance, defect triage, and implementation of readiness to ensure successful business outcomes.
Project: Lending Transformation - Security Bank Philippine ( Sep-23 - Nov 24 ) Responsibilities Led end-to-end Loan Origination System (LOS) transformation covering customer onboarding, application intake, credit assessment,
underwriting, decisioning, collateral evaluation, approval workflows, and loan booking
Led AS-IS assessment, TO-BE design, Fit-Gap Analysis, Functional Design Documentation and requirements traceability (RTM). Partnered with business, operations, technology teams to drive solution design, process optimization and CRM integration. Supported cutover planning, go-live readiness, hypercare stabilization, and adoption of the transformed lending platform.
Business Analyst Mouser Electronics PVT LTD (Pune) (Jun 2023 - Sep 2023)
Project: Finance Transformation - Oracle Fusion Finance Cloud - Account Payable Responsibilities Led business analysis and requirements definition for Oracle Financial Cloud AP implementation, designing invoice-to-pay processes, supplier
onboarding, and payment approval workflows.
Facilitated requirements workshops, process design, and solution validation with finance and business stakeholders. Supported UAT, user training, go-live readiness, and post-production support to drive successful implementation
Business Analyst
FIS (Fidelity Information Services) (Pune) (Feb 2020 - Jun 2023)
Project: FIS Integrated Banking Solution (Core Banking Product) - FIS (Fidelity Information Services) Responsibilities Led business analysis and solution design for FIS IBS Core Banking Platform, shaping product capabilities across CASA, Deposits and Lending
to address evolving client and market needs.
Defined functional requirements, user stories, business rules, and feature specifications for core banking modules, collaborating closely with
product managers, architects, and engineering teams.
Drove product enhancements across customer onboarding, account servicing, loan origination, loan servicing, and payment processing,
improving platform functionality and user experience.
Supported API enablement and digital banking integration capabilities, ensuring seamless interoperability between IBS, digital channels, and
external banking ecosystems.
Led feature validation, UAT support, release readiness, and production deployment activities, ensuring high-quality product releases and
successful client adoption.
Business Analyst
FIS (On Payroll of Magna Infotech Limited) (Pune) (Aug 2019 - Feb 2020)
Project: Finance Transformation - Oracle Fusion Financial Cloud (Accounts Payable) | FIS Global Finance Operation
Responsibilities
Supported Oracle Fusion Financial Cloud AP & Payments implementation, defining invoice-to-pay processes, supplier onboarding, and
payment approval workflows.
Assisted finance teams in the migration from Oracle EBS to Oracle Fusion Cloud, supporting business validation, process alignment, and user
adoption.
Led UAT, training, go-live readiness, and post-production support to ensure successful deployment and operational continuity.
Consultant Axis Securities LTD (Pune) (Aug 2016 - Feb 2017)
Project: Axis Digital- Axis Securities Ltd.
Responsibilities
Managed the full lifecycle of retail banking products—including Home Loans, Personal Loans, Mortgages, Deposits, and CASA—ensuring
seamless customer experience and compliance with KYC/AML regulations and internal risk controls.
